Hi,

Can I get an update on this order? I believe they were originally due to
ship in September.

Thanks,

Al

Hi Al,

Happy to check that for you. I just need one thing to pull the order up: the order number from your confirmation (it looks like Shop····), or the email address you used at checkout. Either one on its own is enough, and if you have neither handy, the postcode ····to plus the full name on the order will do.

Send that back in a reply here and I'll come straight back with where it stands and the current ship date for it. I don't want to quote you a date for the wrong order, so I'll hold off until I've matched it.

Thanks for your patience,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for getting back, I've attached the email confirmation of the order
for you. Email used was this one (email hidden), not sure why the
order numbers are mismatched?

Best,

Hi Al,

Thanks for confirming, I've got it now. The order is Shop····, paid, for the Harlo B30 plus the Power Kit, shipping to (address hidden).

You're right that it was first set for September 5. We wrote to you on September 15 about the delay, by email and text, when the cooling was redesigned for a quieter unit, and that moved the batches back. Your B30 ships October 30. It's a pre-order unit being built for you, and the Power Kit is already reserved for it at our Chattanooga warehouse, so both go out in the same box with tracking by email.

Sorry it has run past the mid-October window you were given. You can follow the incoming batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but October 30 is what your order stands at.

If our emails have been landing in junk, adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will keep the shipping notice out of spam.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
